melder.mutation_research.synthesis.struc.label: StructuralSynthesizer
melder.mutation_research.synthesis.struc.role: AST-guided source composition over two recorded version texts: pick named top-level functions/classes from a donor and splice them into a base (replace same-named, append new, decorators travel) - the SELECTION+SYNTHESIS half of the May surgical-mutation flow (the diff family is the report half). Pure text-in/text-out; never touches custody, never executes, never records.
responsibilities: synthesize(base, donor, take_functions/take_classes) -> composed source + per-selection provenance
unknown selections refuse loudly naming available donor parts; parse errors answer honestly per side
stateless between calls; owned lazily by the MutationResearch root
extract_part(source, name, kind=None) = the query companion (part span/text lookup; misses answer None, unparseable source is loud)
list_parts(source) = the inventory companion (every top-level part with code, source order)
part FINGERPRINTS: list_parts rows carry sha256 over exact part text (depth-3 change index - inventories compare part-by-part without pulling texts)
